title: Protection for Employees from Unfair Retrenchment Practices and Exploitative Employment Contracts
what_it_is: Protection for Employees from Unfair Retrenchment Practices and Exploitative Employment Contracts

sections.label: Retrenchment, RSUs and non-compete questions
sections.summary: Questions ask the Minister for Manpower about unionised firm retrenchments, RSU forfeiture, non-compete clauses and protection from exploitative contracts.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower over the past five years (a) how many unionised firms have carried out a retrenchment exercise without notifying the Ministry; (b) what sectors are these firms in; (c) what policy measures exist to ensure responsible human resource practices and tripartism are maintained when a firm decides to retrench employees, especially at a unionised firm; and (d) what action can be taken against firms and employers who are recalcitrant.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) whether the Ministry tracks the prevalence of restricted stock units (RSUs) that are issued as compensation for mid-level employees in companies; and (b) if so, whether the Ministry condones the forfeiting of unvested RSUs by companies even in the event of a retrenchment, rather than a resignation.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) whether the Ministry tracks the prevalence of non-compete clauses in employment contracts for mid-level employees in companies; (b) if so, whether the Ministry condones the enforcement of such clauses even in the event of a retrenchment rather than a resignation of employees; and (c) what efforts have the Ministry taken to better protect employees from exploitative employment contracts.

sections.label: Tripartite retrenchment guidance
sections.summary: MOM worked with tripartite partners to formulate guidance for employers undertaking cost-cutting, contained in the Tripartite Advisory on Managing Excess Manpower and Responsible Retrenchment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: On responsible practices, we worked closely with the tripartite partners to formulate clear guidance for employers when undertaking cost-cutting measures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: This guidance is contained in the Tripartite Advisory on Managing Excess Manpower and Responsible Retrenchment (TAMEM).

sections.label: Tripartite guidelines on clauses
sections.summary: MOM and tripartite partners are developing tripartite guidelines on reasonable use of such clauses, targeted for release in the second half of this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: MOM and the tripartite partners are, hence, also developing a set of tripartite guidelines to provide guidance on the reasonable use of such clauses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: This will help educate employers and shape norms, similar to how TAMEM is used.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: These guidelines are currently being finalised and we target to release them in the second half of this year.

sections.label: Claims limits and retrenchment as last resort
sections.summary: Employees with claims exceeding Tribunal limits must start a civil claim at the Courts, and MOM will educate companies on cost-saving measures so retrenchment remains a last resort.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: For claims that exceed the claims limits of the Tribunals, employees would need to start a civil claim at the Courts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Speaker
sentences.text: We will continue to work with companies to educate them on possible cost-saving measures, so that retrenchment remains a last resort.

sections.label: MRNs received 2019 to 2023
sections.summary: From 2019 to 2023, MOM received around 16,300 MRNs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: From 2019 to 2023, MOM received around 16,300 MRNs.

sections.label: Retrenchment benefits received
sections.summary: From 2019 to 2023 MRN data, nine in 10 eligible employees received retrenchment benefits.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: When you talk about whether there have been late submissions, it is important to note that today, from 2019 to 2023, from our MRN data, nine in 10 eligible employees received retrenchment benefits.

sections.label: Confidential settlement and FDAWU representation
sections.summary: The settlement terms are confidential and the tripartite agreement and conciliation are respected, but FDAWU can represent Dr Tan's resident in this instance.

sentences.text: The terms of the settlement are indeed confidential.
We respect the tripartite agreement and the conciliation that has been reached.
But the Food, Drinks and Allied Workers Union (FDAWU) will be able to represent Dr Tan's resident in this particular instance.

sections.label: Guidelines on non-compete clauses
sections.summary: New tripartite guidelines on non-compete clauses and restrictive covenants will be released in the second half of this year, protecting manual workers not involved in strategic budgets and operations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: But even before news of this broke out, we were already planning to see how we can establish guidelines to offer higher knowledge, understanding between companies and employers, and also to elevate the level of understanding for these non-compete clauses and restrictive type of covenants for our workers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: That has resulted in a set of new guidelines which is worked out with all of the tripartite partners and which we will be releasing in the second half of this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: So, you can understand that when you set up a new set of guidelines, a lot of pre-work thinking, thought process, engagement and dialogues would have gone on behind the scenes in coming up with this set of guidelines.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: We are very clear in terms of RSUs or non-compete clauses that, in general, manual workers, workmen who are not involved in strategic budgets, operations and so on, will be protected against these restrictive clauses.

sections.label: Retrenchment numbers and advanced knowledge
sections.summary: Retrenchment numbers fluctuate and MOM or tripartite partners cannot have advanced knowledge of retrenchment, which would be a painful measure for senior management.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: And not just retrenchment as an exercise, the number of retrenched employees is also one of those fluctuating numbers; and again, it is something that I believe for the senior management of any particular company, if they should even eventually contemplate going down that route, it would be a very painful measure.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
sentences.text: So, for MOM or the tripartite partners to have advanced knowledge, I do not think that it is possible.
